road_corridors.name: Krung Thon Buri Road / Wongwian Yai

notes: Road polylines are compressed corridor intent. Not surveyed alignments or final lane geometry.
Unmarked intersections do not imply road connections. Split every at-grade crossing into graph nodes during graybox.
Exact turns, lane directions, road widths, junction tangents and access spurs require local reference and driving validation.
All areas remain drive-accessible. Discovery reveals knowledge, not invisible city locks.
No driving through temple courts, park interiors, pedestrian market lanes or expressways.
Passenger ferries are scenery, not vehicle crossings. Bridges are the driving crossings.
Roads tagged invented_gameplay_connector must remain explicitly fictional.
